run_loop: run the Loop worker to continuously process jobs from the queue until an uncaught exception
process_next_job: process the next job from the queue by creating a job runner and running it via JobManager
has_resources: check if the worker has sufficient memory and CPU resources to start a new job
has_memory: check if the current RAM plus swap memory usage is below the configured maximum percentage threshold
has_cpu: check if the current CPU load average is below the configured maximum percentage threshold
